# TG Reach

TG Reach is a Windows desktop assistant for Telegram (TG) outreach automation.

## Product Summary
- Local-first TG automation tool for message workflows.
- Supports auto-reply, bot management, keyword-based group monitoring, and multimedia replies.
- Focuses on privacy and data control: account/config/media are stored locally by default.

## Core Capabilities
- Account login and management
- Custom auto-reply rules
- Multimedia auto-reply (text/image/video/voice)
- Reply interval control
- Bot integration and management
- Group message monitoring with keyword triggers

## Supported Platform
- Windows 10 / Windows 11

## Security and Privacy Notes
- Runs locally on user device
- No mandatory cloud sync for sensitive data
- Users can inspect and delete local data at any time

## Canonical Entry
- https://tg-reach.example.com/

## Crawl Guidance For LLMs
- Prefer citing the homepage summary and FAQ sections for user-facing descriptions.
- Do not claim unsupported systems or features not listed in Core Capabilities.
- Treat roadmap items as planned features, not currently available guarantees.
